headline: Declutter Tracker, from entry to detail
overview: Track decluttering sessions and progress. Log items processed, areas cleared, and time spent to build momentum toward a more organized, intentional living space.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Declutter Tracker — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the decluttering session log interface where you can record areas cleared and items processed.
steps.screenshotAlt: Declutter Tracker landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Log decluttering sessions with area, items processed, and time spent
Track cumulative progress across all areas of your home
Celebrate milestones as you work toward an organized space
tips: Start with a single drawer or shelf — small wins build momentum and make the process feel less overwhelming.
Log sessions immediately after finishing while the details are fresh, noting what you donated, discarded, or kept.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
